cause: The migrated persistent workspace retained the prior virtual-environment directory, but its Torch lib directory was empty and importing torch failed because libtorch_global_deps.so was absent.
proposed_resolution: Create a fresh no-overwrite virtual environment from the exact local pyproject.toml and uv.lock whose SHA-256 values match the prior locked-runtime receipt, validate exact package versions and CUDA/A40 access, then freeze and use that new runtime receipt without altering the broken historical environment.
